svg.aria-label: An HTTP exchange over a persistent connection: one TCP handshake, then several requests and responses reuse the same connection; a conditional GET with If-None-Match returns 304 Not Modified when the cached copy is still valid.
svg.title: An HTTP exchange over a persistent connection: one TCP handshake, then several requests and responses reuse the same connection; a conditional GET with If-None-Match returns 304 Not Modified when the cached copy is still valid.
svg.text: later, cache expired: ask "has it changed?"
